answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network docks each identity at an admission wharf requiring non-refundable cryptographic stake burning. Every identity minting sends a cost ripple through an exponential bonding curve C(n) = k * b^n, turning cheap identity farming into an economic sinkhole. By trapping counterfeit nodes in this financial lagoon through superlinear capital destruction, coordinating an attacking swarm becomes mathematically unprofitable.
